notes: React/MUI storefront but server-side rendered (requests+BS4 works, no JS execution needed). This is the general 'Keräilykortit' (collectible cards) category, not Pokemon-specific — of 66 total products only 12 are tagged Pokemon (see 'Tuotemerkki: Pokemon (12)' filter facet); a real scraper must filter by the 'Pokemon' brand facet or filter client-side on product name. Price is NOT in the visible text (loaded async, page shows a spinner placeholder) — instead read the numeric 'data-ls-price' attribute (e.g. data-ls-price="6.49") off the .lipscore-rating-small span, which also carries 'data-ls-availability' ("InStock"/"OutOfStock") for stock status and 'data-ls-product-url' for the absolute product URL. Pagination uses an offset query param (?offset=60 for page 2) rather than a page number — 60 products per page, 66 total = 2 pages; url_pattern placeholder here is the raw offset value, not a page index (page N offset = (N-1)*60).
